mapper.select: SELECT ,r.total_required_qty quantity,r.base_unit,ms.meal_date,m.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=ms.table_id AND t.account_id=ms.account_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=ms.account_id AND m.menu_id=r.menu_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','COMPLETED') AND t.status<>'CANCELED' AND ms.meal_date BETWEEN #{date_from} AND #{date_to} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id}

SELECT , GREATEST(b.current_base_qty-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.remaining_base_qty) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=b.account_id AND l.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id AND l.location_id=b.location_id AND (l.status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','CONSUMED') OR l.expiration_date<#{date_from})),0),0) quantity,b.base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id AND ap.account_id=b.account_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ap.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id}

SELECT ,ap.safe_stock_base_qty quantity,COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,p.base_unit) base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ap.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id WHERE ap.account_id=#{account_id} AND ap.active_yn='Y'

SELECT ,r.quantity,r.base_unit,ms.meal_date FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status='COMPLETED' AND r.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL #{average_days} DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=CURRENT_DATE

SELECT , GREATEST(oi.order_qty-COALESCE(oi.received_order_qty,0),0)*oi.base_qty_per_order_unit quantity,oi.base_unit, po.requested_delivery_date delivery_date,po.status order_status,oi.item_status, po.purchase_order_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_id=po.purchase_order_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=oi.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=po.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.source_ingredient_id,''),ap.mapped_ingredient_id) WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.requested_delivery_date<=#{date_to} AND po.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','FAILED','RECEIVED') AND oi.item_status NOT IN ('CANCELED','FAILED','RECEIVED')
